title: CultureTechLens Research Corpus
description: The public research corpus of CultureTechLens NFP (Chicago) — Black Cultural Intelligence: 14 flagship Deep Research packages, 26 research briefs, 9 research dossiers, the CultureTechLens Index record, and the Sports lane dossiers. Every claim is evidence-graded (VERIFIED / SUPPORTED / PROVISIONAL / DISPUTED / UNRESOLVED), sourced, and covered by a public corrections record.
